notes.title: TERARIN GAMES' latest title “Blaze of Storm” Steam page is now open!
notes.content:
Blaze of Storm is a vertical scrolling shmup in which you use explosions from a variety of sub weapons to destroy enemies in cyberspace.
Please add it to your wish list.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3513070/Blaze_of_Storm/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3513070/Blaze_of_Storm/[/url]

notes.title: Crystal Breaker is now available
notes.content:
Crystal Breaker is now available. As a launch sale, a 10% discount will be offered until December 5, 2024. Feel free to live stream the game and share screenshots. Have fun! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772080/Crystal_Breaker/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772080/Crystal_Breaker/[/url]

notes.title: Crystal Breaker DEMO is available now!
notes.content:
Includes up to stage 2. Give it a try!
We welcome your feedback.
Feel free to stream the video and post on social media.
The product version will be released in winter 2024.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772080/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772080/[/url]

notes.title: I wrote about Crystal Breaker on my blog.
notes.content:
I wrote about the details of Crystal Breaker's system on my blog. If you are interested, please read it.

notes.title: TERARIN GAMES' latest title "Crystal Breaker" Steam page is now available!
notes.content:
Shoot the enemy at close range! Crystal Breaker is a vertically scrolling shmup that focuses on close range attack. Please add it to your wish list.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772080/Crystal_Breaker/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772080/Crystal_Breaker/[/url]

notes.title: The DEMO version of the latest work "Missile Dancer 2" has been released.
notes.content:
The DEMO version of the latest work "Missile Dancer 2" has been released.
In the DEMO version, you can play Caravan mode (3 minute score attack).
If you like it, please add it to your wishlist and wait for the release of the product version.
Thank you for your continuous support. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566090/Missile_Dancer_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566090/Missile_Dancer_2/[/url]

notes.title: TERARIN GAMES' latest title "Missile Dancer 2" Steam page is now available!
notes.content:
Missile Dancer 2 is a new sprite scaler shmup that combines rail shooter and caravan STG. We are working hard to release the product in 2024. Please add us to your wish list.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566090/Missile_Dancer_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566090/Missile_Dancer_2/[/url]

notes.title: TERARIN GAMES has announced that "Terra Flame" will be released on November 18,
notes.content:
Terra Flame is a horizontal shmup inspired by the 90's. It features a system that allows you to shoot three types of weapons, forward shot, back shot, and search shot, for each button.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1921840/
